verdict.rationale: developers.sift.com is a full API reference portal covering the Events, Decisions, Score, Workflows and Webhooks APIs, with per-language examples (curl, Python, Java and more) and request/response samples. Examples can be run against a separate sandbox environment with sandbox API keys, but the docs explicitly note that no live try-it runner exists, so the reference is browsable rather than interactive. Missing for 10: an in-browser interactive try-it console, examples that run directly from the reference pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
